If `create_model` builds a model over only a subset of `n.snapshots`, `solve_model` still calls `_call_extra_functionality` with all of `n.snapshots`. Under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, `_as_model_snapshots` returns that index unchanged, so the callback receives the full network snapshots rather than the model’s subset.
